reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "register"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "register": a register is filled line by line, so scenes are written in from the top.
Camera "dolly": constant forward movement for a high-energy feed.
Grounds light → accent → light → ink: a cool accent, so a darker ground is used for contrast at a turn.
Most of this audience never unmutes, so nothing depends on sound; cues are kept quieter and sparser for those who do.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on Facebook Reel (0.3s a word), inside 12–26s.
